export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for 'GARDEN REACH SHIPBUILDERS & ENGINEERS LIMITED' lists buyer-side export lanes: 'ROYAL GOVT. OF BHUTAN MINISTRY OFINFRASTRUCTURE & TRANSPORT (MOIT) THIMPHU,BHUTAN — GARDEN REACH SHIPBUILDERS & ENGINEERS LIMITED' (87 shipments) and 'FIRST SECRETARY EMBASSY OF INDIA ... KAPRDHARA MARG-336 KATHMANDU-44600 NEPAL' (359 shipments); page header states 'Total Shipments 1188 Records detected', 'Trading Partners 12', 'Latest Cargo 2025-11-29'. Counter check: the free view rendered only ~5 shipment rows and ~5 buyer rows out of the claimed 1188 records, so per-row B/L numbers, dates and HS codes for the Bhutan/Nepal export lanes were NOT visible — only the aggregate buyer-lane counts. No individual export B/L with date+destination+HS was readable in the free view.
domestic_evidence: GRSE is a listed Navratna defence PSU under Ministry of Defence (own site: 'A NAVRATNA COMPANY UNDER MINISTRY OF DEFENCE, GOVERNMENT OF INDIA'), i.e. a domestic supplier to the Indian Navy/Coast Guard with disclosed revenue in its statutory Annual Reports and Financial Results (Investors Corner: 'Annual Reports', 'Financial Results', 'Corporate Governance Report'). Import-side customs rows confirm live domestic production activity, e.g. '2025-11-21 CATERPILLAR SARL SINGAPORE BRANCH → GARDEN REACH SHIPBUILDERS & ENGINEERS LIMITED, MAIN ENGINE CATERPILLAR MAKE ENGINE MODELC280-16 RATING-6500KW (PO SL NO.10)(USE IN INDIAN NEVAL SHIP) ... KOLKATA SEA, India, HS 84089090, BOL 6493584' — components imported for Indian naval vessels under construction. Exact GST turnover band and contract values were not read in this session (annual report PDF not opened), so revenue figures are left null.
note: Declared HS 890110/890190 (cruise/passenger and cargo vessels) is broadly consistent with the actual business (warships, patrol vessels, ferries), though customs rows seen are mostly inbound machinery spares under HS 84/85/90 — HS not a rejection ground per project rules. Export activity is real but small relative to domestic defence orders: the visible export lanes are government-to-government ferry/vessel supplies to Royal Government of Bhutan and Embassy of India Kathmandu (Nepal), which matches GRSE's known Bhutan ferry export programme. Caveat: the free ImportKey view exposes only aggregate counts for those lanes, not individual B/L numbers/dates, so export evidence is confirmed at lane level, not at single-shipment level. Revenue and export value: null (not public in the pages read). No sanctions/court issues assessed here — out of scope for this role.
